source_behavior.authorization: Content.Edit is required before bulk trash
source_behavior.selection: selected explorer rows are reduced to content type plus WordPress identifier
source_behavior.execution: BulkTrashExecutionService.RunAsync performs bounded per-target WordPress trash mutations and continues across item failures
source_behavior.feedback: Succeeded/failed counts are surfaced to the operator
source_behavior.reconciliation: the explorer reloads authoritative content after the operation

laravel_adaptation.post_mutation_refresh: posts and pages queries are refetched before success feedback

security.tenant_site_ownership: tenant-scoped Site::findOrFail resolves the route-owned site before target processing
security.content_ownership: all selected ContentItem rows must belong to the route-owned site and active tenant before any remote mutation
security.caller_owned_identity_fields: tenant/site/user/actor identity fields are rejected with 422
security.target_boundary: only post/page plus positive WordPress IDs are accepted; duplicates and unavailable targets fail before mutation

execution_semantics.successful_target: moved to trash through ContentPlatformService::mutateContent and reflected in local status
execution_semantics.stale_target: reported as conflict with durable ContentConflict evidence and no overwrite
execution_semantics.remote_failure: reported as failed without aborting remaining selected targets

coverage: exact source BulkTrashAsync contract and canonical route marker
visible Laravel explorer control is mounted and calls the canonical endpoint
foreign tenant and foreign site fail closed with 404
caller-owned identity injection is rejected before remote work
duplicates and unavailable content are rejected before remote work
mixed post/page success mutates both authoritative targets
stale target creates durable conflict evidence without overwrite
remote item failure is isolated and later targets continue
frontend refreshes posts and pages after mutation

terminality.reason: Laravel now renders the canonical BulkTrashAsync control in the tenant/site Explorer, submits only server-validated post/page WordPress targets, enforces content.edit plus tenant/site ownership, preserves optimistic conflict protection, isolates per-target remote failures, reports partial outcomes, and refetches authoritative content after mutation.
